title: Building the Truman Show: A TrustZone-Based Framework for Lightweight Out-of-band Kernel Security Monitoring
abstract: arXiv:2608.29758v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: The increasing number of vulnerabilities in operating systems, together with sophisticated kernel-level threats (e.g., rootkits), has weakened the effectiveness of traditional in-kernel protection mechanisms. Since these defenses operate at the same privilege level as the kernel, they share the same attack surface and can be bypassed once the kernel is compromised. Isolation-based security approaches provide stronger protection by separating security logic from the kernel, but strict isolation often introduces semantic gaps that limit system visibility and hinder timely threat detection. In this paper, we present LOOM, a lightweight out-of-band operating system monitoring architecture built on ARM TrustZone. By leveraging TrustZone's hardware-enforced isolation, LOOM establishes a tamper-resistant monitoring environment independent of the kernel. translated_title: 构建楚门的世界：一个基于TrustZone的轻量级带外内核安全监控框架
translated_abstract: 操作系统中漏洞数量的不断增加，加上复杂的内核级威胁（如rootkit），削弱了传统内核内保护机制的有效性。由于这些防御机制与内核运行在相同的特权级别，它们共享相同的攻击面，一旦内核被攻破就可能被绕过。基于隔离的安全方法通过将安全逻辑与内核分离提供了更强的保护，但严格的隔离往往会引入语义鸿沟，限制了系统的可见性并阻碍了及时的威胁检测。在本文中，我们提出了LOOM，一个基于ARM TrustZone构建的轻量级带外操作系统监控架构。通过利用TrustZone的硬件强制隔离，LOOM建立了一个独立于内核的防篡改监控环境。为了弥合语义鸿沟，我们设计了一个轻量级的语义重构机制……
tldr: LOOM是一个基于ARM TrustZone的轻量级带外内核安全监控框架，利用硬件强制隔离建立独立于内核的防篡改监控环境，并通过轻量级语义重构机制弥合语义鸿沟，实现对内核威胁的及时检测。
en_tdlr: LOOM is a lightweight out-of-band kernel security monitoring framework built on ARM TrustZone that establishes a tamper-resistant monitoring environment independent of the kernel through hardware-enforced isolation, and bridges the semantic gap with a lightweight semantic reconstruction mechanism for timely threat detection.
